name: Claim-Jumper
desc: A salvager who finds it easier to rob divers than to dive.

intro: A patched hard suit drifts out from behind the wreck with a hull torch lit, and a voice on your comms says this claim is theirs now.
You find a second set of mag-boot tracks in the dust on the hull, just before their owner finds you.
hit: The hull torch rakes across you, and your suit alarm starts chirping.
They kick off the bulkhead and slam into you, and a pry bar finds the joint in your armor.
A magnetic grapple pins your arm to the hull, and the torch comes in right behind it.
miss: The torch carves a bright line across the plate beside your head.
They swing the pry bar at you, and the recoil sends them spinning away, cursing.
You duck behind a spar, and the torch cuts it in half instead of you.
crit: The torch finds your air line, and for three long breaths you're doing sums about how much you have left.
defeated: Their boots lose the hull, and they drift slowly away from you, still offering to split it.
They let go of the torch and raise both hands, and ask you whether the Guild really needs to hear about this.
joins: {Enemy} swings in on a salvage line with a torch already lit, looking to take a share of whatever you've got.
stunned: {Enemy} hangs off their line, blinking at you, as the torch gutters in their hand.
